caption: Spatial autocorrelation examples in DLPFC and mouse brain data.
notes: Reads the latest existing DLPFC/MF h5ad objects; no Moran/Geary recalculation. A source manifest verifies that the cached script panels postdate those inputs. The final redraw is emitted as two separate 3-column by 4-row SVGs with receptor/ligand metrics on the left and interaction panels on the right; panel letters are omitted.

steps.name: DLPFC/MF individual maps from precomputed h5ad
